records.source: Huh... I wonder if the messages in this movie are good for our community?
records.translation: 嗯……不知道這部電影傳達的訊息對我們的社區是否有益？

records.source: I saw this movie once, a long time ago. It's very romantic!
records.translation: 很久以前，我看過這部電影。非常浪漫！

records.source: That was lovely... The theme of the movie really resonated with me. Thanks for bringing me!
records.translation: 真美好……電影的主題讓我深有共鳴。謝謝你帶我來！

records.source: I hope the seats are plush, I've been on my feet all day!
records.translation: 希望座椅夠柔軟，我已經站了一整天！

records.source: I'm not much of a movie buff... but I had a good time! Thanks, @.
records.translation: 我不算電影迷……不過看得很開心！謝謝，@。

records.source: Oh man, I'm so excited for this! I heard it has a great soundtrack.
records.translation: 喔，天啊，我太期待了！聽說這部片的配樂很棒。

records.source: This movie's hilarious! How do they come up with this stuff?$h
records.translation: 這部電影太好笑了！他們怎麼想得出這些點子？$h

records.source: Sam can't contain his laughter!
records.translation: 山姆忍不住放聲大笑！

records.source: *psst*... Don't tell anyone, but I wear the same type of socks as Wumbus.
records.translation: *噓*……別告訴任何人，其實我穿的襪子和旺巴斯是同一款。

records.source: So you like scary movies, huh? I'm a little surprised!
records.translation: 原來你喜歡恐怖電影？我有點意外！

records.source: That was pretty good! I'm usually not scared by movies, but that one got to me a little... I don't think I'll take Vincent to see this.
records.translation: 相當不錯！我通常不會被電影嚇到，但這部片讓我有點受不了……還是別帶文森特來看好了。

records.source: Hey, thanks for inviting me, @... It's really great that we have a movie theater in town now.
records.translation: 嘿，謝謝你邀請我，@……鎮上現在有了電影院，真的很棒。

records.source: That wasn't bad! I might have to take Vincent to see this.
records.translation: 還不錯！也許得帶文森特來看。

records.source: It's an old movie with lots of talking, right? Hmm... $s
records.translation: 這是一部充滿對話的老電影，對吧？嗯……$s

records.source: Huh? Oh! Yeah... The movie's... interesting...$10
records.translation: 什麼？喔！對……這部電影……很有意思……$10

records.source: Sam is playing his handheld video game system.
records.translation: 山姆正在玩掌上型遊戲機。

records.source: Yeah... Uh... That one character was interesting... And, um... heh...$10
records.translation: 對……呃……那個角色挺有意思……而且，嗯……嘿……$10

records.source: I'm so excited! My mom said I can have candy, too!$h
records.translation: 我好興奮！媽媽還說我可以吃糖果！$h

records.source: Vincent is having a blast!
records.translation: 文森特看得非常開心！

records.source: That was so fun! I wanna go see it again!$h
records.translation: 太好玩了！我想再看一次！$h

records.source: B... But... This movie is for grown-ups, isn't it?$s
records.translation: 可……可是……這部電影是給大人看的，對吧？$s

records.source: Vincent is fidgeting in his seat.
records.translation: 文森特坐在座位上動來動去。

records.source: That was boring... I didn't understand anything.$s
records.translation: 好無聊……我什麼也看不懂。$s

records.source: Thanks for inviting me to the movies, @. It's not easy to adjust back into the civilian lifestyle, but you've helped me feel really welcome.
records.translation: @，謝謝你邀請我看電影。重新適應平民生活並不容易，不過你讓我感受到大家真心歡迎我。

records.source: This is great... it reminds me of simpler times...$h
records.translation: 真不錯……讓我想起更單純的時光……$h

records.source: Kent has a rare smile on his face.
records.translation: 肯特臉上露出難得一見的微笑。

records.source: That was fun. When you're engrossed in a movie, all your cares and worries disappear.
records.translation: 真有趣。全心投入電影時，所有牽掛和憂慮都會消失。

records.source: I'm not sure about this movie...
records.translation: 我不太確定這部電影……

records.source: Kent is breaking out into a cold sweat...
records.translation: 肯特開始冒冷汗……

records.source: That was challenging for me. Still, I appreciate you inviting me to this.
records.translation: 這對我而言很難熬。不過，還是謝謝你邀請我。

records.source: This movie's supposed to be a romance, right? *sigh*$s
records.translation: 這應該是一部愛情片，對吧？*嘆氣*$s

records.source: Why would she like THAT guy? Totally unrealistic if you ask me...$3
records.translation: 她怎麼會喜歡那個傢伙？要我說，一點也不現實……$3

records.source: Clint is scowling.
records.translation: 克林特皺起眉頭。

records.source: That movie was depressing...$s
records.translation: 那部電影真令人沮喪……$s

records.source: I guess it's 'guys night', huh? Does that mean I have to buy my own snacks?^Oh... A... Are we on a date, then?$4
records.translation: 看來是「兄弟之夜」，對吧？這表示點心得自己買嗎？^喔……那……那我們算是在約會嗎？$4

records.source: It's just... *hic*... Joja Cola.$h^*whispers*...If you're, um... tired... you can put your head on my... my shoulder. Heh... or not!$4
records.translation: 只是……*嗝*……Joja 可樂。$h^*低語*……如果你，呃……累了……可以把頭靠在我的……我的肩膀上。嘿……不靠也行！$4

records.source: Clint is taking sips from an unmarked flask.
records.translation: 克林特小口啜飲著沒有標籤的酒壺。

records.source: Hey... that was kind of fun... right?$h
records.translation: 嘿……還挺有意思……對吧？$h

records.source: I ate a handful of nuts to prepare for this movie... brain food!
records.translation: 為了看這部電影，我先吃了一把堅果……給大腦補充營養！

records.source: I feel a little bit smarter than I was before... don't you?
records.translation: 感覺自己比剛才聰明了一點……你呢？

records.source: When I saw the movie poster for this one, I felt a very positive sensation in the top of my head.$h
records.translation: 看到這部電影的海報時，我在頭頂感受到一股非常正向的感覺。$h

records.source: That movie felt very spiritual, in a way... don't you agree? I loved it!$h
records.translation: 那部電影在某種程度上非常有靈性……不覺得嗎？我很喜歡！$h

records.source: I'm happy to see a movie with you! I tend to get totally lost in the screen.
records.translation: 很高興能和你一起看電影！我總會完全沉浸在銀幕中。

records.source: I feel positive after that one... that means it was a good movie!$h
records.translation: 看完後感覺很正向……這表示它是一部好電影！$h
